performancePolicies.title: Performance policies
performancePolicies.description: Tune Pingora for different node sizes. Connected nodes begin syncing as soon as a policy changes.
performancePolicies.assignedCount: {count, plural, one {# assigned node} other {# assigned nodes}}
performancePolicies.defaultDescription: Applies to existing and newly added nodes without an explicit assignment.
performancePolicies.defaultCount: {count, plural, one {# node uses this policy} other {# nodes use this policy}}
performancePolicies.automaticSummary: Automatic worker and upstream pool sizing
performancePolicies.threadCount: {count, plural, one {# worker thread} other {# worker threads}}
performancePolicies.editDescription: New policies start with filled defaults. Updating startup settings such as workers or listeners automatically reloads the node.
performancePolicies.name: Policy name
performancePolicies.deleteDescription: Nodes using this policy will switch to the default policy.
performancePolicies.assignDescription: Selected nodes will use this policy. Clearing an assignment switches the node to the default policy.

threads.label: Worker threads
threads.help: Start with the node's CPU core count.

threads_auto.label: Automatic configuration
threads_auto.help: At startup, the node sizes worker threads and the idle upstream connection pool using the CPU cores and memory available to the process.

work_stealing.label: Work stealing
work_stealing.help: Idle workers can process tasks from other workers' queues.

listener_tasks_per_fd.label: Tasks per listener socket
listener_tasks_per_fd.help: Increasing this value allows parallel connection acceptance.

upstream_keepalive_pool_size.label: Idle origin pool size
upstream_keepalive_pool_size.help: A larger pool can improve connection reuse and consumes more file descriptors.

max_retries.label: Origin attempt limit
max_retries.help: Includes the initial attempt. Set to 1 to disable retries.

runtime_enable_alt_timer.label: Alternative runtime timer
runtime_enable_alt_timer.help: Uses the alternative Tokio timer and requires work stealing.

fast_timeout_to_tokio_threshold_seconds.label: Tokio timer threshold
fast_timeout_to_tokio_threshold_seconds.help: In seconds. Timeouts at or above this duration use Tokio.

runtime_metrics_poll_time_histogram.label: Task poll duration metrics
runtime_metrics_poll_time_histogram.help: Collect a histogram of asynchronous task poll durations.

connection_timeout.label: TCP connection timeout
connection_timeout.help: In seconds. Use 0 for runtime defaults.

total_connection_timeout.label: Total connection timeout
total_connection_timeout.help: In seconds, including the TLS handshake. Use 0 for runtime defaults.

read_timeout.label: Origin read timeout
read_timeout.help: In seconds. Use 0 for runtime defaults.

write_timeout.label: Origin write timeout
write_timeout.help: In seconds. Use 0 for runtime defaults.

idle_timeout.label: Idle origin connection lifetime
idle_timeout.help: In seconds. Use 0 for runtime defaults.

upstream_tcp_keepalive.label: Origin TCP keepalive
upstream_tcp_keepalive.help: Starts probing after 60 seconds of idle time, every 15 seconds, up to 4 times.

upstream_tcp_recv_buf.label: Origin TCP receive buffer
upstream_tcp_recv_buf.help: In bytes. Use 0 for the system default.

verify_cert.label: Verify origin certificate
verify_cert.help: Validate the trust chain of the TLS certificate.

verify_hostname.label: Verify origin hostname
verify_hostname.help: Match the hostname in the TLS certificate. Requires certificate verification.

upstream_alpn.label: HTTPS origin protocol
upstream_alpn.help: Select which HTTP protocol to negotiate for HTTPS origins.

max_h2_streams.label: Concurrent origin HTTP/2 streams
max_h2_streams.help: Limit active streams per HTTP/2 origin connection.

h2_stream_window_size.label: Origin HTTP/2 stream window
h2_stream_window_size.help: Initial receive window per stream, in bytes.

h2_connection_window_size.label: Origin HTTP/2 connection window
h2_connection_window_size.help: Initial receive window for the connection, in bytes.

max_concurrent_streams.label: Concurrent downstream HTTP/2 streams
max_concurrent_streams.help: Limit active streams per client connection.

initial_window_size.label: Downstream HTTP/2 stream window
initial_window_size.help: Initial receive window per stream, in bytes.

initial_connection_window_size.label: Downstream HTTP/2 connection window
initial_connection_window_size.help: Initial receive window per client connection, in bytes.

max_frame_size.label: Maximum downstream HTTP/2 frame size
max_frame_size.help: Maximum HTTP/2 frame payload in bytes.

max_header_list_size.label: Downstream HTTP/2 header limit
max_header_list_size.help: Limit the decoded request header list size, in bytes.

header_table_size.label: Downstream HPACK table size
header_table_size.help: In bytes. Use 0 to disable the dynamic table.

max_send_buffer_size.label: Downstream HTTP/2 send buffer
max_send_buffer_size.help: Maximum buffer size per stream, in bytes.

upstream_connect_offload_threadpools.label: Dedicated origin connection pools
upstream_connect_offload_threadpools.help: Use 0 to connect on regular workers.

upstream_connect_offload_thread_per_pool.label: Threads per origin connection pool
upstream_connect_offload_thread_per_pool.help: Applies when dedicated origin connection pools are enabled.

downstream_tls_offload_threadpools.label: Dedicated downstream TLS handshake pools
downstream_tls_offload_threadpools.help: Use 0 to handle handshakes on regular workers.

downstream_tls_offload_thread_per_pool.label: Threads per TLS handshake pool
downstream_tls_offload_thread_per_pool.help: Applies when dedicated downstream TLS pools are enabled.

keepalive_request_limit.label: Requests per keep-alive connection
keepalive_request_limit.help: Applies to HTTP/1.x. Use 0 for no limit.

h2_idle_timeout.label: Downstream HTTP/2 idle timeout
h2_idle_timeout.help: In seconds. Use 0 to leave idle connections open.

h2c.label: Cleartext HTTP/2
h2c.help: Allow HTTP/2 on the cleartext listener.

so_reuseport.label: Listener port reuse
so_reuseport.help: Allow multiple sockets to bind to the same address and port.

tcp_fastopen.label: TCP Fast Open queue length
tcp_fastopen.help: Requires operating system support. Use 0 to disable.

listener_tcp_keepalive.label: Downstream TCP keepalive
listener_tcp_keepalive.help: Starts probing after 60 seconds of idle time, every 15 seconds, up to 4 times.

tcp_snd_buf.label: Downstream TCP send buffer
tcp_snd_buf.help: In bytes. Use 0 for the system default.

tcp_recv_buf.label: Downstream TCP receive buffer
tcp_recv_buf.help: In bytes. Use 0 for the system default.

ipv6_only.label: IPv6-only listeners
ipv6_only.help: Applies to listeners bound to an IPv6 address.

dscp.label: Downstream DSCP marking
dscp.help: Range 0 to 63. Use 0 for the default.

cache_enabled.label: Node caching
cache_enabled.help: Allow site cache rules to take effect on this node.

cache_capacity_mib.label: Cache capacity
cache_capacity_mib.help: Object capacity of the in-memory cache, in MiB.

cache_max_object_mib.label: Maximum cached object
cache_max_object_mib.help: Maximum size of one cached object, in MiB.

cache_lock_wait_timeout.label: Cache lock wait timeout
cache_lock_wait_timeout.help: Seconds to wait for an in-progress origin fetch of the same object.

cache_max_lock_retries.label: Cache lock retry limit
cache_max_lock_retries.help: Number of cache lookup retries after waiting.
